name: table
description: A data table styled in place: header rule, row lines, optional stripes, hover, and cell borders, with numeric columns that line up.

attributes.name: data-size
attributes.description: Cell padding and text size; sm is the compact table.

attributes.name: data-hover
attributes.description: Tint the row under the pointer.

attributes.name: data-border
attributes.description: Borders around every cell instead of lines between rows, as a box draws its border.

attributes.name: data-nowrap
attributes.description: Every cell keeps its line; put the table in a scroller.

attributes.name: data-fixed
attributes.description: Fixed table layout: the columns share the width equally, whatever their content. A width on a first-row header cell makes that column wider and the rest share what is left.

children.description: The header row. With data-sticky it pins at --yeti-sticky-offset as the rows scroll under it, painted with the surface and carrying its rule.
A cell (or header cell) of numbers: end-aligned with tabular figures.

markers.name: data-numeric
markers.description: Tabular figures, so digits line up, on any element; on a table's cells and headers the column is end-aligned too.

markers.name: data-nowrap
markers.description: Keeps this text on one line, on any element.

markers.name: data-align
markers.description: Aligns the text of this cell, or of every cell in this row. A cell's own data-align or data-numeric outranks its row's.

tokens.name: --yeti-table-stripe
tokens.description: Fill of even rows with data-striped.

tokens.name: --yeti-text-md
tokens.description: Text size when data-size is absent.

tokens.name: --yeti-space-sm
tokens.description: The space step when data-size is absent; a cell's inline padding follows it.

tokens.name: --yeti-weight-strong
tokens.description: Weight of the caption and of header cells.

tokens.name: --yeti-border-width
tokens.description: Width of the row rules, and of every cell border with data-border.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-surface
tokens.description: Background of the head cells when the head is pinned with data-sticky.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-surface-sunken
tokens.description: Background of a row under the pointer with data-hover.

a11y.notes: Give the table a caption, or aria-label / aria-labelledby. Header cells carry scope="col" or scope="row". A table wider than its container goes inside a scroller with tabindex="0" and a label; the table itself never changes shape, so it stays a table for assistive tech.
